title: Best robot mower deal: Save $500 on the Ecovacs Goat 01000
excerpt: Set the robot on a schedule and forget pushing a mower around was ever part of yard work.
content_html:
SAVE $500.99: The Ecovacs Goat 01000 robot lawn mower is on sale at Amazon for $999, down from the normal price of $1,499.99. That's a 33% discount.

Credit: Ecovacs

$999 at Amazon
$1,499.99 Save $500.99

Now that we're squeaking out the last bits of summer enjoyment, it's no time to focus on chores. Household tasks can wait until the chill and dark months. Some tasks can handle waiting, but others will still need attention. That's very true of lawn maintenance since we'll all be in the backyard as much as possible. Instead of pushing the mower yourself, employ the help of a robot lawn mower.

As of July 29, the Ecovacs Goat 01000 robot lawn mower is on sale at Amazon for $999, down from the normal price of $1,499.99. That's a 33% discount that matches the record-low price at Amazon.

Mashable Trend Report

Just like we've come to use robot vacuums inside, a robot lawn mower can keep the yard tidy outside. The Ecovacs Goat 01000 can mow up to a quarter of an acre with wire-free mapping and intelligent obstacle avoidance.

Instead of pushing a loud mower around, let the Ecovacs take over with a quiet mowing experience. From the app, set your desired mowing schedule and kick back with a hands-off way of tackling chores. You also get to set the desired cutting height between 1.2 and 3.1 inches.

When it comes to precision, the Ecovacs has the smarts to avoid over 200 common obstacles, and it can handle mowing on slopes of up to 45 degrees. The narrow mower can fit through spaces as narrow as 2.6 feet which is ideal for yards with raised garden beds or landscaping.

Since the Ecovacs Goat 01000 robot lawn mower is sitting at a record-low price and no one has time for more summer chores, make the upgrade for under $1,000. You'll be able to sit back and watch the robot do the hard work while sipping a chilled beverage.

现在我们正在享受最后的夏日乐趣，现在没有时间专注于家务事了。 家务活可以等到寒冷和黑暗的月份再做。 有些任务可以处理等待，但其他任务仍然需要注意。 草坪维护也是如此，因为我们都会尽可能多地呆在后院。 与其自己推割草机，不如借助割草机器人的帮助。

截至 7 月 29 日，Ecovacs Goat 01000 机器人割草机在亚马逊上的售价为 999 美元，低于正常价格 1,499.99 美元。 这是 33% 的折扣，与亚马逊的历史最低价格相当。

可混搭趋势报告

就像我们在室内使用机器人吸尘器一样，机器人割草机也可以保持室外院子整洁。 Ecovacs Goat 01000 具有无线测绘和智能避障功能，可割草面积达四分之一英亩。

让科沃斯带来安静的割草体验，而不是推着一台吵闹的割草机。 从应用程序中，设置您想要的割草时间表，然后以不干涉的方式处理家务。 您还可以将所需的切割高度设置在 1.2 到 3.1 英寸之间。

在精确度方面，科沃斯可以智能地避开 200 多个常见障碍物，并且可以在最大 45 度的斜坡上进行剪草。 狭窄的割草机可以穿过狭窄至 2.6 英尺的空间，非常适合带有高架花园床或景观美化的庭院。

由于科沃斯 Goat 01000 机器人割草机的价格创下历史新低，而且没有人有时间做更多的夏季家务，因此可以以不到 1,000 美元的价格进行升级。 您可以坐下来观看机器人完成艰苦的工作，同时喝着冰镇饮料。
